evidence_quote: We report a case of Alexander's disease in a black South African boy of 9 years.
note: Diagnosis by brain biopsy; pre-gene era, no variant reported.

evidence_quote: The case of a woman who had a mild mental and physical handicap all her life is described.
note: Adult case presented by the authors as Alexander's disease on necropsy findings; no genetic testing; earlier adult cases discussed only in prose.

evidence_quote: Eighty-two participants with AxD, confirmed by GFAP testing, were enrolled, and the disease phenotype was determined using clinical and imagin features (56 cerebral, nine intermediate, and 17 bulbospinal).
note: Natural-history cohort reported only as group statistics.
